text: Think about your first two minutes. Was it clear what to tap and what you were trying to do? What, if anything, confused you?
Which phone and browser are you playing on? (For example: iPhone 13, Safari.)
Did anything look broken, get cut off, or feel hard to tap on your phone? Tell us what and where.
How does the speed of the game feel so far?
When you pick upgrades, does the choice feel like it matters? Is there one you wish you had skipped or bought sooner?
You opened the Shop. How did that moment feel?
The rocket launched. Were you surprised? Did it feel worth the wait? Say what you expected.
